additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: AW: ID0406384-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P7 170000784] Adjust screensaver and logo CRM:00579001497
additional_info.body:
Hi Alica,
The image you just shared has more pixel in width, then maximum requirement. (Refer Attachment)
The dimension of image is now
372
x 132 Pixel, which is above the
280
x 840 pixel size.
Allow me to explain it by simple example, why the logo image will always appear smaller in the width.
The bigger rectangle represents the dimension of screensaver within HMI, while the smaller rectangle (in Green) represents the size for Logo. As you can see the space available for logo image has higher height than width, hence the image shared by you will always be visible in small space as it doesn't have content which can occupy maximum height.
I hope this explanation helps. So if you can share the logo image which can have higher space occupancy in height (840 pixel), the logo will appear slightly bigger.
Let me know if you need further information. Lookinh forward to hearing from you.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
